title: DelayedRxReadyEvent orphans when stash pruned
description: Code review finding (9098.18 fix): when _prune_delayed_rx() removes entries from _delayed_rx dict, corresponding DelayedRxReadyEvent remains in queue until processed. The handler is a no-op, so events are harmless but consume peak memory during simulation. Improvement: remove_events_for_node-style cleanup for delayed RX, or track event IDs in _DelayedRx tuple for targeted removal.
